description.value: The Ocean Beach is a historic waterfront pub housed in a building dating back to 1930 — originally part of the Blue Moon Empire and later the Ocean Beach Hotel — now rebranded in 2020 under the long-standing Veltri family. Perched on Marine Drive in White Rock with direct ocean views, the industrial-chic interior features oak décor and old-world brick, making it a natural and atmospheric stop for cyclists on the waterfront route. The menu spans craft cocktails, seafood platters, and hearty bar food with plant-based options.
